description: Main FastAPI application source code for the NoteGPT API, including endpoints for user authentication, note management, YouTube AI processing, exporting, and sharing.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User data model representing application users.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Note data model representing user notes, including YouTube links, content, and sharing info.

methods.name: register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint for registering new users with email and password.

methods.name: login_user(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, returns JWT token.

methods.name: create_note( note_in: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new note, optionally processing YouTube URL with AI transcription and summarization.

methods.name: list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: List all notes belonging to the logged-in user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by ID with access control.

methods.name: edit_note(note_id: int, note_edit: NoteEdit, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))

ingest_youtube( youtube_url: str = Query(..., description="YouTube video URL"), title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the generated note"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None )
methods.description: Process a YouTube URL to generate and create a note with AI audio transcript and summary.

methods.name: export_note( note_id: int, format: NoteExportFormat = Query(..., description="Export format: pdf or txt"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Export a note as PDF or plain text.

methods.name: share_note( note_id: int, share_mode: NoteShareMode, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Publish or unpublish a note for sharing.

methods.name: get_public_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Access a public note by ID without authentication.

methods.name: root()
methods.description: Root endpoint providing a welcome message.
